verdict.rationale: cubic documents an org analytics dashboard with AI coding, AI review impact, and delivery-speed tabs; the AI review tab shows whether reviews are helping the team. An Analytics API also exposes PR-level counts of issues flagged versus fixed, which covers findings and an implied acceptance or fix rate. Missing for 10: an explicit acceptance-rate metric, explicit review-coverage metrics (share of PRs or repos reviewed), detail on the dashboard's actual charts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
